summary: Recent coverage highlights advocacy efforts around DC statehood, including content from statehood-focused publications and updates on challenges to the District's local authority. Advocates note that DC's population exceeds that of some existing states, and statehood groups have documented and responded to what they characterize as attacks on DC's local authority. Without statehood, Congress reviews the District's laws and can vote to repeal them.
